entry.title: Cathedral of Saint Mother Teresa in Pristina

terrainReference.basis: Standard DEM datum 585.753036m; estimated common church floor 1.8m clears sampled church/tower peak 1.433m. Foundations and low platform edge follow coarse terrain; front stairs are an estimated transition, not surveyed steps. Raw5m platform height retained but interpreted at common floor. Exact court/street/door thresholds, absolute altitude and certified walking unverified.
